noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

rendererType.description: The target field to hold data retrieved by the annotated data spec.

title:
A custom renderer for a field in UiDesigner.  Certain field types do not have an easily determined
renderer, such as toggle for boolean or input for text.  In these cases, we want to specify a component to render
the value of the field.
name: Ann.UiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer
